briefdescription.para: Holds the configuration of each supported flash device.
Identifies the flash in the Flash Configuration Table (FCT).

parameterdescription.para: JEDEC read ID of the flash device.
Pointer that stores the matching FCT table index.

briefdescription.para: Defines the flash configuration table of the serial flash library.

detaileddescription.para: This file contains the definitions of the flash configuration table.
